ينهزل (form VII)
# يَنْهَزِلُ (yanhazilu) /jan.ha.zi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# يَنْهَزِلَ (yanhazila) /jan.ha.zi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# يَنْهَزِلْ (yanhazil) /jan.ha.zil/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
